units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:11">Num. R. s. 14<sup>11</sup></cite> <he>בירכו באמרי ש׳ … שְׁפָרִים</he> he blessed him with speeches of beauty, for his words were pleasing.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI, 6 שכרן של מצות שְׁפָרוֹ עלי (not מצוה) (naḥălath means) the reward of good deeds; its splendor rests on me; a. e.
